# Agentic First

> Top-level directory of Agentic First tools:
> public surfaces that help companies, people, and agents publish,
> discover, verify, and use source-owned information.

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## Main Routes

- `/` - Agentic First tools directory and route map
- `/companies/` - company/person profile directory and publishing overview
- `/companies/mcp` - company/profile MCP endpoint
- `/companies/healthz` - company/profile health endpoint
- `/companies/schemas/` - canonical company/profile schemas
- `/companies/feedback` - company/profile feedback endpoint
- `/companies/llms.txt` - machine index for the company/profile directory
- `/directory/` - Agentics Tool Directory seed catalog
- `/directory/llms.txt` - machine index for the Tool Directory

## Source Repositories

- Top-level site: https://github.com/yqup/agentic-first
- Companies and Tool Directory product code: https://github.com/yqup/pitch-mcp

## Concept

Agentic First means designing public information and private access paths so
agents can read, verify, and act safely. The top-level site is the directory
of the available Agentic First tools.

Use this distinction:

- Humans set goals, values, approvals, risk appetite, and judgement calls.
- Agents read structured information, perform bounded work, and escalate where approval is required.
- Organisations publish source-owned facts instead of relying only on third-party profiles or scraped pages.

## Product Surfaces

Use `/companies/` when the task concerns source-owned profiles about
companies or people: publishing/storing company information online, schema
validation, submissions, scans, feedback, or the public MCP tools.

Use `/directory/` when the task concerns the Agentics Tool Directory:
tools, standards, runtimes, protocols, and operations surfaces for
agent-native work.

## Legacy Company/Profile Compatibility

The legacy public MCP endpoint is:

- https://directory.agentic-first.co/mcp

The target endpoint is:

- https://agentic-first.co/companies/mcp

Keep the legacy endpoint available during migration. Proxying is safer
than redirecting for MCP clients until client compatibility is confirmed.
